description: LEI lookup (Legal Entity Identifier) from the official GLEIF register. Look up by LEI code or search by legal name (optional jurisdiction filter). Returns the official legal name, entity status, registration status (ISSUED/LAPSED), jurisdiction, legal form and registered address, with a direct GLEIF source link per record. Legal entities only. Ideal cheap first check before deeper company screening.
